SR-516.his_version: Is a perfect Higher/True Self already waiting in there to be your guide or parent? I'd call that claim spiritual bypassing. I've experienced that Higher Self perspective myself, though, in very powerful meditations and altered states. For example, one time, while still married to my first wife Ann, who was becoming more violent and crazy as time went on, we got super high on weed and we were both in some higher realm as our higher selves. My higher self asked her higher self, "Are you going to keep getting more and more crazy?" Her higher self said, "Yes." It was like we could see the whole timeline of life from above. Although, my friends already told me the same thing, quite sober. 😅
